name: Portsmouth
seo_title: Portsmouth Christmas Events for Kids 2026: 7 Events, 2 Free
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Portsmouth, Virginia for 2026: 7 family events, 2 free, with dates, times and addresses checked on each host's site.
lede: Portsmouth keeps Christmas in Olde Towne and City Park, with a tree lighting party, a market on High Street, a lights train at the park and the Coleman collection of holiday scenes.
celebrates: Portsmouth's holiday season centers on Olde Towne and Portsmouth City Park. The city's Tree Lighting Party fills High Street with face painting, crafts, Santa's arrival by fire truck and a tree lit by the Snow Queen and Sugar Plum Fairy. Portsmouth Parks and Recreation runs Holiday Nights at the Park, where families ride the Pokey Smokey II past more than 150,000 lights. Saturdays bring the Holiday Market on High Street, and the Portsmouth Art and Cultural Center shows the animated Coleman Nursery Collection in Winter Wonderland. The Children's Museum of Virginia adds Snow Wonders on its Museum Mall.
lastyear: We did not find a published 2025 recap with attendance or highlights for Portsmouth, so the 2026 listings on this page come straight from the host websites. The city calendar calls Holiday Nights at the Park award-winning and says it is back this year, and the Art and Cultural Center brings back Winter Wonderland with the Coleman collection. Check each host page for current times, tickets and weather changes, since this year's Tree Lighting Party was already moved from November 22 to November 28 because of the forecast.
facts: Portsmouth Tourism says the Coleman collection began over 50 years ago at Coleman's Nursery, which opened Christmas Wonderland to the public in 1965 after the owners were inspired by the Small World ride at the 1964 World's Fair. By 1982 it had 260 animated figures and over 100,000 lights. After a fire that year the community helped rebuild it, and the Portsmouth Museums Foundation and the city bought the display in 2004. It now shows at the Portsmouth Art and Cultural Center.
trains: Portsmouth has its own small Christmas train: Holiday Nights at the Park at Portsmouth City Park lists a ride on the Pokey Smokey II to see more than 150,000 twinkling lights, for $2 per person for ages 3 and up. The Children's Museum of Virginia has a train exhibit, and a donor note on the Portsmouth Museums Foundation site mentions touring Molly the Train. For a railroad museum, our Suffolk Seaboard Station Railroad Museum page is the closest train museum page we have in the area.
train_links: An 1885 depot with a model of Suffolk in 1907, listed on our Virginia train museums page.
traditions: A free Olde Towne party with Santa arriving by fire truck and a tree lighting by the Snow Queen and Sugar Plum Fairy.
A $2 lights night at Portsmouth City Park with the Pokey Smokey II train ride, crafts and a lighted playground.
The Coleman Nursery Collection of animated holiday scenes at the Portsmouth Art and Cultural Center, with Santa visits.
Saturday shopping with local makers, glassblowing demonstrations and storefront Coleman displays.
A second Saturday in December festival with carolers, a Children's Parade and holiday music.
kidfact: The Coleman collection began in 1965, and one of its first stars was an animatronic Santa who snored in bed with a feather over his nose and a sign that said not to wake him until December 24.
faq: What Christmas events can kids enjoy in Portsmouth?

Families can go to the Tree Lighting Party in Olde Towne, Holiday Nights at the Park at Portsmouth City Park, Winter Wonderland at the Portsmouth Art and Cultural Center, the Holiday Market on High Street, the Olde Towne Holiday Music Festival, Snow Wonders at the Children's Museum of Virginia and the Coleman Collection Nativity Scene. Each listing has its own date, time and price.
Is there a Christmas train in Portsmouth?

Yes. Holiday Nights at the Park at Portsmouth City Park lists a ride on the Pokey Smokey II past more than 150,000 twinkling lights, with advance tickets at $2 per person for anyone 3 and older and free entry for youth 2 and under with a paying adult.
Where can kids meet Santa in Portsmouth?

Santa arrives by fire truck at the Tree Lighting Party at 3 pm on November 28, and he is at Winter Wonderland at the Portsmouth Art and Cultural Center on Fridays, Saturdays and Sundays until December 20. The city calendar lists his hours on the Winter Wonderland page.

It is a set of animated holiday scenes that began at Coleman's Nursery in 1965. Portsmouth Tourism says it now shows at the Portsmouth Art and Cultural Center as Winter Wonderland, and the nativity scene from the same collection is at Monumental United Methodist Church on weekends.
Are there free Christmas events in Portsmouth?

Two are listed free: the Tree Lighting Party on November 28 and Snow Wonders at the Children's Museum of Virginia, though museum entry itself needs a ticket. Other events charge small amounts such as $1 for Winter Wonderland, $2 for Holiday Nights at the Park and $3 for the Olde Towne Holiday Music Festival.

We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.
